name: org.machanism.machai:gw-maven-plugin
description: GW Maven Plugin is the Maven integration adapter for Machai Ghostwriter and Guided File Processing. It applies AI-assisted, repeatable maintenance workflows to a repository's documentation, site pages, source code, tests, configuration, and other selected files. The aggregator goal gw:gw finds embedded @guidance instructions and processes them; gw:act executes a predefined act or an inline prompt. The corresponding gw:gw-per-module and gw:act-per-module goals run in Maven's standard reactor context. The plugin resolves Maven project, session, reactor, classpath, settings, paths, exclusions, instructions, model settings, and provider credentials before delegating file work to Ghostwriter processors. It can run aggregator goals without a pom.xml, coordinates multi-module traversal, supports parallel Maven execution, and exposes class-discovery and reflection tools to AI workflows. Typical uses include maintaining Maven-site documentation, reviewing Java projects, applying reusable repository acts, and grounding generated documentation in compiled-class metadata.

usageContext: Run AI-assisted guidance processing from Maven
Run predefined acts or prompt-only repository tasks
Maintain documentation and Maven-site content alongside source code
Process multi-module Maven projects through aggregator or reactor goals
Discover and inspect Java classes during Ghostwriter workflows

constructors.description: Creates the thread-safe aggregator Maven mojo for the gw:gw goal. Maven creates it internally to configure a GuidanceProcessor and scan selected files for embedded Ghostwriter guidance.

examples.description: Maven resolves the plugin by coordinates, creates org.machanism.machai.gw.maven.GWMojo, and processes guidance in the selected documentation directory.

constructors.description: Creates the thread-safe aggregator Maven mojo for the gw:act goal. Maven creates it internally to resolve an act name or inline prompt and execute an ActProcessor.

examples.description: Maven downloads the plugin if necessary, constructs org.machanism.machai.gw.maven.ActMojo, and applies the review act to Java source files.

constructors.description: Creates class-discovery and reflection function tools for one Maven project's compile classpath and output directories.

examples.description: Advanced integrations can create the tool with an org.apache.maven.project.MavenProject; normal mojo execution registers it automatically.

features.name: Guidance-driven processing
features.description: Executes gw:gw. This aggregator goal creates a GuidanceProcessor, applies model, scan path, instructions, exclusions, provider configuration, Maven context, and optional Java tools, then processes files containing @guidance comments. It can work with a project tree or a directory without a Maven project.

examples.description: After plugin configuration, scans site markdown, adds workflow instructions, skips generated output, and performs the embedded guidance requests.

features.name: Act execution
features.description: Executes gw:act. The goal accepts a predefined act, an act plus additional text, or a prompt-only value prefixed with >. Aggregator traversal processes submodules before parent modules.

examples.snippet:
mvn gw:act -Dgw.act=review -Dgw.path=src/main/java
mvn gw:act '-Dgw.act=>Update project documentation' -Dgw.path=src/site/markdown
examples.description: The first invocation runs a named act. The second uses a direct user prompt; its leading > distinguishes it from an act name.

features.name: Per-module Maven processing
features.description: Executes gw:gw-per-module once for each Maven reactor module. This non-aggregator, thread-safe goal requires a Maven project and uses Maven's reactor execution context.

examples.description: Uses Maven reactor scheduling to process each module's site content while allowing Maven parallel execution.

features.name: Find Java classes
features.description: Finds fully qualified class names whose simple names match a regular expression in the registered Maven project context. More than ten matches require a narrower expression.

examples.description: Finds candidate Maven mojo classes for a subsequent API inspection.

features.name: Inspect Java class metadata
features.signature: public java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object> org.machanism.machai.gw.maven.tools.ClassFunctionalTools.getClassInfo(java.lang.String className, java.io.File projectDir) throws java.lang.ClassNotFoundException
features.description: Returns structured reflection and origin metadata for a fully qualified class, including accessible members, constructors, annotations, hierarchy, class path, source path, and dependency coordinates when available.

examples.description: Retrieves API metadata that an AI-assisted documentation workflow can use to describe the guidance goal accurately.

customizations.name: gw.path
customizations.description: Selects a file, directory, glob, or supported pattern to scan. Aggregator defaults use the execution-root directory and per-module defaults use the module directory.

examples.description: Restricts guidance processing to Maven-site markdown.

customizations.name: gw.act
customizations.description: Selects an act name, an act name followed by extra prompt text, or a prompt-only task whose first character is >.

examples.snippet: mvn gw:act '-Dgw.act=>Add missing public API documentation'
examples.description: Runs a direct prompt instead of resolving a named act.

customizations.name: genai.serverId
customizations.description: Names a Maven settings.xml server entry from which the plugin reads provider credentials and custom provider configuration.

examples.description: Uses credentials stored in the my-ai-provider Maven server entry rather than placing secrets on the command line.

examples.title: Install, configure, and run guidance processing
steps: Install a JDK and Maven, and configure access to a Ghostwriter-compatible GenAI provider.
Add the plugin declaration to the build plugins section.
Place @guidance instructions in the documentation or source files to maintain.
Run the short Maven goal from the project root and review the changes.
examples.description: This practical workflow installs the Maven component through the project build, configures its scan location and credential-server id, then processes embedded guidance in site markdown.

examples.title: Invoke without modifying the project POM
steps: Configure provider credentials in Maven settings.xml or the Ghostwriter configuration used by the environment.
Run the plugin using its fully qualified Maven coordinates.
Review the documentation updates produced from embedded guidance.
examples.description: Maven resolves and invokes the plugin directly, which is useful for a one-off repository maintenance task.

examples.title: Run an act against documentation
steps: Choose a predefined act or write a one-off task prompt.
For a prompt-only task, begin the gw.act value with >.
Set gw.path to the intended content and run the act goal.
examples.command: mvn gw:act '-Dgw.act=>Update the getting-started documentation for current plugin behavior' -Dgw.path=src/site/markdown
examples.description: Applies a direct documentation task without requiring a separately named act definition.
